title: Desktop and Endpoint Engineer
description:
About us

We’re a beacon of trust for news, content and data. At the heart of our group is the Press Association, the UK and Ireland’s national news agency. Across The PA, we’re investing in technology that helps us deliver faster, work more effectively and make AI useful and accessible to our people.

We’re also beginning an exciting new chapter in Leeds. Our new home at West Village will bring colleagues from across the business together in the heart of the city centre, just a seven-minute walk from Leeds station.


About the role

We’re looking for a Desktop and Endpoint Engineer (Mac and Microsoft 365) to help colleagues get the best from their technology. You’ll combine responsive technical support with endpoint management, automation and service improvement, with a particular focus on strengthening our Mac service.

AI is a major part of our technology strategy. You’ll help colleagues adopt AI tools safely, identify everyday tasks that could be automated and make sure our workplace technology


What you will be doing
  • Resolve issues across macOS, Windows, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 and workplace technology, keeping colleagues informed throughout.
  • Manage the Mac lifecycle through Apple Business Manager and Microsoft Intune, from enrolment and configuration to updates and retirement.
  • Improve device setup and support through zero-touch deployment, scripting and automation.
  • Spot practical opportunities to use AI and automation to make work easier for colleagues.
  • Contribute to projects that improve collaboration, security and the experience of working across The PA.


What we need from you
  • Experience supporting macOS in a business environment.
  • Experience managing endpoints through Microsoft Intune or a similar platform.
  • Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, automated device enrolment, configuration profiles or Mac application deployment.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365, identity, access, authentication and device compliance.
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows, iOS and Android devices.
  • A structured approach to resolving hardware, software, network and collaboration issues.
  • Clear communication skills and a strong focus on colleague service.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities, take ownership and maintain accurate documentation.

Experience with scripting, Windows Autopilot, application packaging, Teams Rooms, audiovisual technology or generative AI tools would be helpful.

The role may include occasional travel or support outside normal working hours for major events and business critical activity.


What we offer.

At PA you’ll receive a benefits package designed to support your life in and outside work, including:

  • 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, with a holiday purchase scheme.
  • Annual Wellbeing Day and eight hours of paid volunteering time.
  • Pension, life assurance, Wellhub access, learning opportunities and a Bupa Health Cash Plan through salary sacrifice.
  • A fantastic modern workplace at West Village in the heart of Leeds city centre, just a seven-minute walk from Leeds station.
  • Rooftop terraces, collaborative spaces, a wellness studio, showers and extensive cycle storage.
  • A brilliant city-centre location with shops, cafés, restaurants and bars on the doorstep, plus exclusive discounts across Leeds covering food and drink, fitness, entertainment and accommodation.
